description: Bob wants to design a diet consisting of protein bars and noodles. Assume that each serving of noodles costs $5 and contains 600 calories and 1.5 grams of protein. Assume that each serving of protein bar costs $2.5 and contains 250 calories and 5 grams of protein. He's interested in spending as little money as possible but he wants to ensure that his meals have at least 2000 calories and at least 16 grams of protein per day. Formulate a linear programming problem that will help minimize the cost of the diet.

CostProteinBars.definition: Cost per serving of protein bars

CaloriesProteinBars.definition: Calories per serving of protein bars

ProteinProteinBars.definition: Protein per serving of protein bars

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of protein bars and noodles while meeting the daily calorie and protein requirements."

constraints.description: 600 * (servings of noodles) + 250 * (servings of protein bars) >= MinCalories
1.5 * (servings of noodles) + 5 * (servings of protein bars) >= MinProtein

ServingsNoodles.definition: Number of servings of noodles consumed per day

ServingsProteinBars.definition: Number of servings of protein bars consumed per day
